source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 5 Holders
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, there were approximately 1,580 shareholders of record of our Class A subordinate voting shares.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the information table of its Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no Shopify shares (searched by issuer name). Holders of record: Class A subordinate voting shares (the listed class). The 10-K separately states 22 holders of record of Class B restricted voting shares and 1 Founder share; not added.
